market_data.window: Effective local date minus10 through plus10 calendar days, bounded by2026-09-18 inclusive; UTC request covers whole local dates
market_data.source_vintage: Fresh retrieval with fixed entity asof; asof does not freeze adjustment vintage or historical availability.

comparison_rules.session: Interpret source and Alpaca timestamps in America/New_York; compare original prior session and exact reported effective session. Do not forward-fill. Retain raw timestamps and missing sessions.
comparison_rules.factor: Use (split_close/raw_close) before divided by same quantity on effective date; expected reciprocal of provider new/old ratio. Later adjustment factors cancel. Volume factors are separate descriptive checks with rounding and coverage caveats.
comparison_rules.numeric_price_interval: Each value has absolute uncertainty max(0.0005 USD,abs(value)*0.0000005), accommodating three-decimal adjusted API output and float32 source rounding. Engineering precision tolerance, not an economic spread allowance.
comparison_rules.factor_acceptance: Expected factor must lie inside propagated positive-price interval; if interval width/expected exceeds0.02 mark precision-insufficient rather than corroborated. Ratios use provider event components as recorded; primary notice semantics checked separately.
comparison_rules.cross_provider_nominal_close: Compare original reconstructed nominal close and independent raw close with sum of their declared price intervals. Outside tolerance is discrepancy, not automatic bad-price proof; revisions/session conventions retained.
comparison_rules.volume: Compare inverse adjustment factors allowing each returned volume rounding by1share; no coverage agreement inferred because venues/conditions/revisions can differ.
comparison_rules.notice: Primary issuer,exchange,SEC or depositary evidence must explicitly identify issuer/action/date/ratio; corporate action type matters. Noninteger provider factors may encode distributions rather than splits. No guessed share repair.
comparison_rules.classification: Report price-factor checks, original nominal-price checks and action-notice evidence separately. Corroborated requires independent factor and action semantics/date agree; contradicted needs positive contradictory evidence; missing or ambiguous evidence unresolved. None qualifies full action accounting.
comparison_rules.cash: Fractional rights, cash-in-lieu, depositary charges and broker settlement remain separately unresolved unless directly evidenced. No corrected strategy or portfolio return.

primary_notice_search: At most two targeted discovery searches per selected event initially, then only direct primary references; preserve all queries, URLs, responses, failures. No substitutes for unavailable events.
reuse: AIXI is not selected; previous AIXI evidence stays separate and is not redownloaded.
prohibited: No raw-source correction, production changes, model fitting, paper/live orders, journal access, authentication flow, funds transfer or paid services.
